name: The Midnight Bar
creator: [Jmelt] Kurisu
description: The Midnight Bar is an Oculus Quest and PCVR bar world commissioned by the group Midnights In Valhalla and built by [Jmelt] Kurisu. Its design draws inspiration from the visual novel [VA-11 Hall-A](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/VA-11_Hall-A), centering on an elaborate drink-mixing system where different concoctions produce different effects on the player. What began as a personal streaming space grew into one of VRChat's most-visited bar worlds, racking up several million visits and spawning a wider community of affiliated bar groups.
